description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Clutch Release Arm.
This part attaches to the clutch release shaft on one end and the clutch cable on the other end.
ATTACHMENT BOLT & NUT INCLUDED!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clutch Release Arm
Qty 1 – Bolt
Qty 1 – Nut
Qty 1 – Cable Spring
Qty 2 – Cable Washers
Qty 1 – Cable Nut
Qty 1 – Cable Pin
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
